import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
})

K_values = [3, 5, 7]
eta_max_sig = [3, 0, 0]
keff_sig = [4, 10, 9]

x = np.arange(len(K_values))
width = 0.32

color_eta = '#E69F00'
color_keff = '#0072B2'

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 3.5))

# Shaded transition zone between K=3 and K=5
ax.axvspan(0.5, 1.0, alpha=0.10, color='gray', zorder=0)
ax.text(0.75, 11.3, r'$K^* \in (3,5)$', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=9, color='0.4', style='italic')

# Horizontal dashed line at y=12
ax.axhline(y=12, color='0.6', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.8, zorder=1)
ax.text(2.42, 12.3, 'all conditions', ha='right', va='bottom', fontsize=8, color='0.5')

bars_eta = ax.bar(x - width/2, eta_max_sig, width, color=color_eta, label=r'$\eta_{\max}$', edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, zorder=3)
bars_keff = ax.bar(x + width/2, keff_sig, width, color=color_keff, label=r'$K_{\mathrm{eff}}$', edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, zorder=3)

# Bar labels
for bar, val in zip(bars_eta, eta_max_sig):
    ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + 0.3, str(val),
            ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color=color_eta)

for bar, val in zip(bars_keff, keff_sig):
    ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + 0.3, str(val),
            ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color=color_keff)

ax.set_xlabel('Panel size $K$')
ax.set_ylabel('FDR-significant conditions (of 12)')
ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels([str(k) for k in K_values])
ax.set_ylim(0, 13.5)
ax.set_yticks(range(0, 13, 2))
ax.legend(loc='upper right', framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='0.8')

fig.tight_layout()

out_dir = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0519_2/projects/cert_manip_resist_eval/docs/paper/figures'
fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/fig_regime_transition.pdf')
fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/fig_regime_transition.png')
print('Done')
